title: Current official enum option cross-checks for labels in Rough.txt
authority: Live official Garena Craftland Enum reference page
purpose: Capture the option rows currently visible in the official Enum reference for a useful subset of the labels from Rough.txt, and compare them with the older third-party PC library mirror's raw member counts/aliases.

policy.note: Rows are transcribed from the current official Enum reference's visible tables. Where old-mirror counts differ materially, completeness and installed-editor support remain unverified; never infer Mobile dropdown parity.

caveats: This is a cross-check of visible official Enum-reference rows, not a full crawl of every enum/type or every project-specific dropdown.
The official page does not establish that each enum is exposed as a dropdown in Craftland Mobile.
The old extension library is a v1.5.0 secondary snapshot; its raw member counts include duplicate/deprecated aliases.
The two source sets can differ in casing, display label versus script name, and deprecation annotations. Preserve all fields and verify exact installed signatures before code generation.
